summary: Astra bibliographic correction: distinguish Diop’s 1960 cultural/technical/industrial original title from the economic/cultural title of the revised 1974 edition. Preserve the 1960 event ID/date and all reading limits; add two library metadata sources. No new people, nodes, edges or dated events.
authorization: User, 2026-10-24: ask Astra to review the work and push after making corrections. Independent Astra review identified the edition/title conflation (AR1).
rationale: Library edition records are narrower than the retrospective publisher biography used by the earlier packet. The correction changes displayed bibliography/date labels, the existing event label/support and the added anticolonial roster work string; original acceptance records remain frozen and exactly reconstructible. It makes no new argument claim and retains book-unread and named-reader qualifications.
